area: Framework temp claim TTL vs sealed build
finding: Framework temp claims expire after 30 minutes with no renew or ttl option, but a full sealed runner rebuild takes about 40 minutes and runner publication re-checks that exactly one live release-surface claim exists at the end of the build. The build failed with "Runner publication requires exactly one active release-surface claim ... found 0" until an external keepalive loop re-claimed every 15 minutes. After expiry, re-claim returns ATM_FRAMEWORK_STALE_LOCK_CLEANUP_REQUIRED and a release is needed first.
expectedBehavior: Provide framework-mode renew (or let a running governed build heartbeat its own claim) so long sealed builds and commits do not need ad-hoc keepalive scripts.
evidenceOrRepro: 0.1.31 build attempt 1 exited 1 with the found 0 error; attempt 2 with a 900 s re-claim loop exited 0.
followUp: Keep fail-closed behavior for genuinely abandoned claims; only the owning running build should extend its lease.
